Problem Statement Cardano's next growth phase depends on two critical protocol upgrades: Peras (faster finality) and Leios (higher throughput).
Together they unlock significantly higher transaction volume, staking rewards, and TVL.
However, these upgrades do not deliver value on their own — they require: 1.
Production-grade mainnet delivery — Peras v1 remains undeployed on mainnet.
